### Breaking changes
* With [the deprecation of Atlas Device Sync](https://github.com/realm/realm-js/blob/main/DEPRECATION.md) all sync related features got removed and this package now requires Realm JS v20 or above. [#6879](https://github.com/realm/realm-js/pull/6879)

### Compatibility
* Realm JS >= v20
* React Native >= v0.71.4
* Realm Studio v15.0.0.
* File format: generates Realms with format v24 (reads and upgrades file format v10).

第一個可以拿去架自己站的版本。koimsurai.com 就是用這一版跑的。
The first release you can run as your own site. koimsurai.com runs on it.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Koimsurai/sora-to-ki.git && cd sora-to-ki
cp .env.example .env && cp .env.backend.example .env.backend
docker compose up -d
docker compose logs backend-rs | grep setup   # 初次設定的網址 / the setup link
```

**這一版有什麼 / What's in it**

- 初次設定精靈：用 GitHub 或 Google 登入認領
